tools.name: glass-animal-tool-20261015.json
tools.description: Turn a supplied mesh or model into a static prismatic glass sculpture, with controllable tint, rainbow flashes, opacity and faceting. Preview it in Unity, then export a new prefab with separate material and mesh assets.
tools.command_template: Unity menu: Tools > Unity Unicorn > Glass Animal Tool
requirements: Unity 2022.3 Built-in Render Pipeline; install the editor script and prismatic-glass-20261015.shader.
Supply your own model; imported static meshes require Read/Write enabled.
limitations: Original shader approximation; no reference-world model or shader is included.
Static sculpture output. Headset and exact visual-match validation remain open.
